rules: A keepClear zone bars the kinds it lists; kinds are planter, lamp, bollard, tree, parasol, band.

Every Handover point (mission.json destinations and crew): nothing that stands on the ground (planter, pot, tree, lamp, bollard) within 1.2 m. A canopy overhead (parasol, marquee) may cover a point (lead's ruling, 2026-10-14, B2 follow-up); its reason then says what the play camera loses of a person standing there (camera direction from a point: +0.866 x, -0.5 y, 1.28 m out per metre of height).
A crossing landing (crossings below: 1.8 m deep and 4 m wide inside the kerb at its point) bars planter, lamp, bollard and tree.
Bands are flat inlay (4 mm): they may pass under a Handover point or a walk. They may not enter a bay, crew-line-getaway, the steps or landing, or a planting bed.
Lamp rings (InlayArc_R2_W06, four per ring, R 2.3 outside) go only where `ring` is true and are centred on the pole.
Anything not placed here stays off the ground between the two buildings: ask Vantage.
